description: This file defines the Image model class in the Opencart ecommerce platform. It provides functionality for resizing images, including checking for existing resized images, creating necessary directories, and performing the resize operation using the Image library.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling image resizing tasks within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to the specified dimensions, creates cache if necessary, and returns the URL to the resized image.
